Run K-Fold Cross Validation for PGDCM Models

run_pgdcm_cv.Rd

Run K-Fold Cross Validation for PGDCM Models

Usage

run_pgdcm_cv(
  config,
  k_folds = 5,
  lossFunction = "MSE",
  return_samples = FALSE,
  estimation_config = list(niter = 1000, nburnin = 100),
  nCores = 1,
  nBootReps = 200
)

Arguments

config

Model configuration list from build_model_config.

k_folds

Integer. The number of folds to split the data into. Default is 5.

lossFunction

Character. The loss metric to evaluate predictions against held-out data. Must be one of "MSE" (Mean Squared Error) or "predictive" (log predictive density). Alternatively, an R function can be provided. Default is "MSE".

estimation_config

List of parameters controlling MCMC execution (niter, nburnin). Defaults to list(niter = 1000, nburnin = 100).

nCores

Integer. Number of CPU cores to use. Mac/Linux only. Default is 1.

nBootReps

Integer. Number of bootstrap samples for Monte Carlo error estimation. Default is 200.

Value

A list with cross-validation results:

  • CVvalue: The aggregated CV loss metric.

  • CVstandardError: Standard error of the CV value.

  • foldCVInfo: Loss metrics for each individual fold.
